scope: Concrete MORA Clear Witness Cup architecture replacing the revision 6 unit-level fiber collar with transparent primary packaging and minimal black direct print.
key_decision: 단일 컵에서 paper, fiber collar, adhesive label과 printed flavor color를 제거한다. 투명한 validated food-contact vessel을 통해 실제 요거트 색과 내부 trace가 SKU 차이를 맡고, 필요한 정보는 컵 외면의 최소 검정 direct print와 one-time foil에만 남긴다. Paper/fiber는 여러 sealed cups를 지지하는 외부 multipack에만 허용한다.

clear_witness_rule.definition: Transparency earns its place only when the actual food remains safe, stable and visually truthful through the validated shelf life. The cup reveals product evidence; it never substitutes visibility for barrier, hygiene or legibility.
rules: Actual food color, particle, ribbon, veil, thread, marble or oil interface is the only SKU color system on the single cup.
Black print names and explains the product but does not paint, frame or simulate the edible trace.
The clear wall must remain clear enough after filling, chilling, condensation and handling to show the food without retouching or artificial saturation.

If light, oxygen, moisture, aroma, recipe stability or shelf-life requirements cannot be met by a transparent validated structure, stop or materially revise the Clear Witness Cup rather than hide the risk with a paper collar.

If mandatory black copy cannot remain legible against all six actual foods, first revise zone, type scale and geometry; use a narrow integrated non-paper information alternative only after direct-print tests fail.
No sustainability, recyclability, freshness, tamper, easy-peel, food-safety or cold-retention benefit follows from transparency itself.
clear_witness_rule.visual_test: With all printed recipe names covered, each approved SKU must still be distinguishable by its actual food state; with the food digitally desaturated, front, back, bottom and foil functions must remain understandable without a label or color marker.

layer_architecture.name: Actual food
layer_architecture.job: 공통 yogurt density와 recipe-specific internal trace가 제품 정체성, 감각 방향과 fill truth를 직접 보여 준다.
layer_architecture.locked_direction: Only approved R&D food samples may define color, opacity, particle, ribbon, veil, thread, marble and oil-interface appearance.
visible_evidence: 컵 측면을 통해 보이는 실제 food body와 분포
foil을 제거한 뒤 넓은 상부에서 보이는 untouched surface
first spoon 뒤에도 서 있는 ridge와 내부까지 이어지는 trace
validation_gates: actual recipe and common-density specification
recipe stability, syneresis, sediment, oil separation and color change through intended shelf life
consumer acceptance of seeing natural batch variation and any harmless visible separation
food-styling and photography locked to approved production-tolerant samples

layer_architecture.name: Transparent validated food-contact vessel
layer_architecture.job: 요거트와 직접 접촉하고 fill, seal, refrigerated storage, transport, grip and spoon use를 견디면서 실제 food state를 가리지 않는다.
form_lock: directional low-wide 150 g single-serve cup; approximate diameter-to-height ratio 1.55:1 remains subject to line and pack tests
lightly tapered transparent sidewall with no molded paper texture, amber tint, green tint or cosmetic glass simulation
wide opening and rounded internal floor-wall transition reachable by a spoon
flat continuous flange matched to the selected peelable foil
stable foot with a protected bottom-code zone and no decorative pedestal
no rigid overcap, paper skin, fiber grip, adhesive paper label or sidewall window because the vessel itself is the view
layer_architecture.material_direction: Clear food-contact polymer or validated equivalent selected from actual recipe, fill-seal, barrier, migration and recovery-system evidence. No resin family, barrier layer, recycled content or mono-material claim is locked by this concept.
layer_architecture.optical_direction: Neutral clear, low-haze and low-color-cast only after actual wall thickness, forming and cold-condensation tests. Optical clarity is a production metric, not a premium claim.
validation_gates: complete component structure and applicable-market food-contact documentation
overall and specific migration under actual dairy fat, acid, salt, oil, time and temperature conditions
light, oxygen, moisture and aroma barrier needed by each recipe or justified worst case
transparent-wall light exposure and photo-oxidation risk through actual retail lighting and shelf life
fill temperature, seal compatibility, wall compression, top load, nesting, denesting, drop and vibration
odor and taste neutrality, extractables, pigments or additives if present
haze, clarity, stress whitening, scratch, scuff and color cast after forming and cold-chain handling
condensation behavior, hand grip and barcode/copy visibility
actual component mass and local sort/recovery route before any recycling statement
layer_architecture.kill_gate: If a transparent structure cannot meet validated product protection and shelf life without misleadingly hiding the food, the clear-vessel direction does not release.

layer_architecture.name: Minimal black direct print
layer_architecture.job: 투명 용기를 가리지 않고 brand, recipe identity, mandatory facts and variable traceability를 검정 한 색으로 지속적으로 전달한다.
print_lock: black exterior print only on the single cup; no ingredient-color ink, white flood, beige field, metallic ink or transparent varnish used as decoration
no opaque front panel, border, ruled grid, wraparound wallpaper or simulated paper texture
no ink, coating or registration mark on the food-contact interior, rim or foil seal land
consumer artwork uses one modern sans hierarchy and open spacing; manufacturing registration targets remain outside the consumer artwork or in controlled trim/test areas
fixed and variable information occupy separate zones and remain readable without a removable label
layer_architecture.print_character: Crisp neutral black with actual production tolerances visible at close range; premium value comes from accurate registration and durable legibility, not dense ink coverage.
validation_gates: ink, primer, coating and cure compatibility with the selected clear vessel
migration, set-off and odor/taint assessment including exterior-to-interior contact during nested-cup storage
adhesion, cure, scratch, cold rub, condensation rub, grease transfer and dishwasher or reuse claims excluded unless separately tested
front-back-bottom registration on the tapered formed cup
type, barcode and variable-code legibility across curvature, food backgrounds and condensation
Black Sesame black-on-dark contrast and Fig Leaf near-ivory low-edge contrast under retail and home light
print line speed, cup indexing, nesting/denesting damage and defect inspection
effect of direct print on actual local sorting and recovery before any environmental claim

layer_architecture.name: Full-perimeter peelable foil
layer_architecture.job: primary flange를 전 둘레 밀봉하고 최초 개봉 상태와 한 번의 peel action을 명확하게 만든다.
construction_lock: flat full-perimeter seal matched to the selected vessel, not a decorative paper disc
one large asymmetric pull tab that can be grasped without covering front or back copy
one-time complete removal; no hinge, propped lid, rigid reclosure or cosmetic overcap
matte or low-glare foil appearance defined by the actual validated laminate, not luxury foil stamping
black-only essential identity or open cue if printing is required; no recipe-color locator
visible_evidence: sealed flat plane and continuous rim contact
removed foil lying flat beside the cup in opened-state imagery
validation_gates: actual foil, sealant, lacquer, primer, ink and vessel compatibility
seal temperature-pressure-dwell operating window and production line speed
rim contamination control and defined integrity inspection/reject method
peel force across shelf life and cold/wet-hand usability
seal integrity, leak, burst or appropriate test, drop and distribution vibration
light, oxygen, moisture and aroma barrier contribution required by the transparent vessel
migration, set-off, delamination and foil-tear behavior
component separation and local recovery evidence before foil or pack recycling claims

layer_architecture.name: Outer paper or fiber multipack only
layer_architecture.job: 여러 sealed clear cups를 냉장 유통 중 지지하고 outer logistics, recipe list and barcode information을 제공한다. Paper/fiber is not attached to the single cup.
construction_direction: open-sided tested board tray, carrier or restraint that keeps clear sidewalls and direct print visible
directional 2x2 core-four and 2x3 full-six arrangements pending cup and distribution tests
die-cut wells or dividers that do not press foil tabs, hide date codes or imply insulation
black print only preferred so actual cups remain the lineup color system
no transparent plastic window, laminated luxury box, magnetic closure or paper sleeve transferred onto individual cups
validation_gates: full-load drop, vibration, compression, carry and refrigerated humidity
condensation, board strength, ink rub and barcode scan
cup restraint, airflow, case and pallet fit, cold-room handling
board, coating, adhesive and print BOM
local collection, sorting and reprocessing evidence before paper, recyclable, responsible or low-impact claims
layer_architecture.cold_chain_boundary: The outer multipack restrains cups but does not refrigerate or insulate them. Validated refrigeration operation controls product temperature.

front.communication_job: 한눈에 brand, recipe, food category direction and unit size를 읽히게 하면서 실제 음식이 가장 큰 색 면으로 남게 한다.
front.layout: One unframed vertical or centered black hierarchy occupying the minimum readable area. MORA is compact, recipe name is primary, category and quantity sit below; no white backer, flavor color, border, grid or batch theater.
front.visibility_gate: Validate on the filled and condensed cup from straight front, 30-degree turn and normal hand distance. If Black Sesame or another real food removes contrast, revise zone and type before considering an integrated fallback.

back.communication_job: 제품 선택 이후 필요한 mandatory facts and factual traceability를 한 개의 읽기 열로 제공한다.
fixed_family_structure: nutrition and required category facts position
barcode quiet zone and scan orientation
variable_content: line or plant code if required
back.layout: Single black information column with distance-based grouping, not an apothecary grid. Keep the densest copy away from maximum curvature and normal grip pressure; barcode orientation follows verified scanner performance.
back.visibility_gate: Legal-copy area, type size, line length, print distortion, actual food background, condensation and barcode grade must pass on every SKU.

bottom.communication_job: production identification and material facts that do not need the front view, while remaining accessible before opening.
fixed_molded_or_printed: cavity or mold identifier for quality control
verified component material identification only when accurate and required
small orientation datum for print registration if invisible in normal use
variable_code: line and time code where required
prohibited: customer name, city, maker signature or decorative batch number
unverified recycling, resin, reusable or environmental symbol
bottom.visibility_gate: Code remains machine and human readable after cold storage, condensation, base scuff and multipack contact; market review decides whether date information may live only on the bottom or must be duplicated on the back.

foil.communication_job: sealed-unit identity and opening cue without becoming a fourth marketing face.
fixed_print: MORA or recipe name only if required for sealed-unit identification
variable_print: lot/date only if line architecture and market rules require it
foil.layout: Black only, broad empty foil plane, no ingredient color, numbered formula, ruled label or faux handwritten date.

variable_after_fill_or_seal: line, plant or time code if required
fixed_vs_variable_print.separation_rule: Variable coding uses a reserved bottom or lower-back zone and cannot overwrite fixed legal copy, barcode quiet space or transparent product-view area. No variable customer name, city or performative maker date is allowed.
fixed_vs_variable_print.plate_change_rule: A flavor change requires the correct SKU-fixed artwork and verified recipe; black ink does not permit one generic cup to be relabeled by an ingredient-colored sticker.

six_sku_differentiation.family_rule: All six cups share transparent vessel geometry, black print, foil geometry and information order. The visible food, recipe name and validated sensory copy are the only SKU differences on the unit pack.

skus.actual_food_witness: ivory dense yogurt with a validated pale amber ribbon and fine thyme trace visible through sidewall and spoon cut
skus.not_printed: No amber band, green herb marker, honey gradient or botanical illustration.
skus.release_gate: Actual ribbon and herb trace remain safe, stable and legible without artificial color or garnish.

skus.actual_food_witness: near-ivory yogurt with a validated restrained green-beige internal vein
skus.not_printed: No sage panel, leaf silhouette or green-tinted vessel.
skus.release_gate: Ingredient safety and legality pass first; the food trace remains distinct from plain yogurt and Olive Oil without saturation.

skus.actual_food_witness: warm cream-beige yogurt with validated fine roasted-grain flecks at multiple depths
skus.not_printed: No brown band, kraft effect, grain pattern or rustic speckle printed on the cup.
skus.release_gate: Flecks remain suspended and visually distinct from Black Sesame while common density and shelf stability hold.

skus.actual_food_witness: cool ivory yogurt with validated yellow-orange peel threads or zest points continuing below the surface
skus.not_printed: No orange panel, fruit photo, peel graphic or neon freshness cue.
skus.release_gate: Actual peel species, safety, size, bitterness and stability pass; threads do not become a topping or jam layer.

skus.actual_food_witness: ivory and stone-grey yogurt marble with validated fine sesame particles and visible density
skus.not_printed: No charcoal pack, black luxury field or sesame-dot pattern.
skus.release_gate: Direct black copy remains readable on the darkest production-tolerant sample; otherwise zone/type or the narrow integrated fallback must solve legibility before release.

skus.actual_food_witness: ivory yogurt with a validated translucent olive-gold oil ribbon and truthful interface; visible salt only if the recipe actually retains it
skus.not_printed: No olive-green band, metallic gold, oil-grade cue, salt crystals or origin graphic.
skus.release_gate: Oil oxidation, phase behavior, salt state, cold-chain stability and meal-adjacent comprehension pass without retouching pooling or separation.

six_sku_differentiation.comparison_gate: Photograph sealed, sidewall, opened and first-spoon states under fixed light and cup fill. If actual food differences disappear without color grading or decorative garnish, the relevant recipe or Clear Witness role must be revised.

preferred_direct_print.why_consider: Potentially efficient for repeated tapered-cup artwork and black-only production
preferred_direct_print.not_locked_until: cup geometry, ink/cure, line speed, front-back registration, nesting and cold-rub trials pass

preferred_direct_print.why_consider: Potentially useful where higher black opacity or durable exterior coverage is required
preferred_direct_print.not_locked_until: type detail, taper distortion, ink build, cure, migration/set-off and throughput trials pass

preferred_direct_print.why_consider: Prototype, pilot or short-run artwork and variable test production
preferred_direct_print.not_locked_until: production speed, cure, adhesion, migration, barcode and unit economics pass; do not depict a specific industrial mechanism before selection

production_candidates.inspection_action_for_visuals: Show a generic validated tapered-container registration fixture: cup indexed, black front/back zones inspected for placement, adhesion and clarity. Do not invent a printer head, roller, pad or industrial process before production selection.

integrated_non_paper_fallback_only_if_ne.candidate: narrow resin-compatible in-mold information rail or equivalent integrated non-paper construction with a minimal neutral opacity backer
integrated_non_paper_fallback_only_if_ne.allowed_reason: Only if direct black print cannot meet mandatory legibility, barcode, migration, durability or line-economics gates across the six real food backgrounds.
boundaries: not a paper label, fiber collar, shrink sleeve, pressure-sensitive sticker or full wrap
minimum width and opacity needed for facts, leaving the actual food as the dominant visible surface
black-only consumer artwork; no ingredient-color field
resin and label structure, migration, forming, adhesion, sorting and recovery impacts must be revalidated
fallback cannot be called mono-material or recyclable without actual system evidence

rejected_candidates: paper or fiber collar on the individual cup
white painted cup with transparent window
black printed sticker used to cover contrast failure

production: 1. Form or source the validated transparent food-contact cup and inspect flange, wall clarity, stress, dimensions and bottom-code zone.
2. Apply the correct fixed black front/back direct print to the exterior, fully cure it, inspect registration and control nesting/set-off before food contact use.
3. Denest without scuffing print or clear wall; inspect the interior and keep rim and seal land clean.
4. Fill the approved recipe at validated dose and temperature with minimum structure damage.
5. Apply the matched full-perimeter foil under the validated seal window.
6. Perform weight, seal-integrity, print, clarity and required product checks; add variable lot/date/line code in the reserved zone and reject unreadable or incomplete units.
7. Chill and hold within the validated process; test condensation, rub and code after cooling rather than only on dry empty cups.
8. Place sealed units directly into the tested outer multipack with no individual paper assembly step, then move through monitored refrigerated storage and distribution.
consumer: 1. Through the clear wall, the consumer sees actual food color and trace; black front copy confirms the recipe without a flavor-color marker.
2. The consumer checks the flat intact foil and any required date/storage information before opening.
3. One hand grips a clear non-printed or validated print-safe area while the other lifts the asymmetric tab.
4. The foil peels off completely and is set flat beside the cup; no paper collar or lid is removed.
5. The untouched top surface and sidewall food state align, then one spoon exposes density and the internal trace.
6. After use, foil, clear vessel and outer multipack are handled according to only the locally verified sorting instruction; absence of a collar does not itself prove recyclability.
use_failures_to_test: wet hand slips on the clear cup
black print rubs or transfers under condensation
consumer covers mandatory copy while gripping
foil tab is hard to find against the clear rim
food looks separated, discolored or visually inconsistent before the validated shelf-life end
bottom date code is inaccessible or illegible in retail use

barrier_and_light: Map recipe-specific sensitivity to light, oxygen, moisture and aroma loss.
Test the transparent vessel plus foil under actual retail illumination, distribution and intended shelf life.
Use worst-case or every-SKU justification; Black Sesame oil and Olive Oil oxidation, Citrus aroma and light-sensitive changes require explicit review.
Do not solve failed protection by color grading, an outer paper collar or untested sustainability copy.
food_contact_and_migration: Lock complete cup, barrier layer if any, direct ink, primer, coating, foil, sealant and multipack BOM.
Run applicable overall/specific migration and taint assessment for actual dairy fat, acid, salt, oil, time and temperature.
Include nested-empty-cup set-off because exterior direct print may contact another cup interior before filling.
Revalidate the integrated non-paper fallback as a new structure if introduced.
condensation_rub_and_optics: Measure print adhesion, cold rub, wet rub, scratch, scuff, haze and stress whitening after chill and distribution.
Check hand grip and copy legibility with realistic condensation, not dry studio-only cups.
Reject any ink transfer to hands, multipack or adjacent cups and any optical distortion that falsifies food color.
print_registration_and_legibility: Test front, back, bottom and foil registration across taper, forming tolerances and line speed.
Verify legal type, barcode, variable code and product name against all six real food backgrounds.
Set inspection limits for missing print, double image, distortion, cure, code contrast and artwork-SKU mismatch.
seal_and_cold_chain: Validate matched flange and foil seal window, rim contamination control, integrity method and reject criteria.
Test peel force, clean peel, leak, drop, vibration and top load through the stated shelf life.
Validate fill temperature, cooling curve, storage, transport, retail display and consumer shelf-life conditions with monitored product data.
The clear cup and board multipack do not create refrigeration or prove freshness.
sorting_and_recycling_claims: Identify actual cup and foil structures, ink coverage, coatings, barriers and integrated fallback if any.
Evaluate consumer separation, local collection, sorting detection and real reprocessing routes for each market.
Assess whether black direct ink, barrier layers or in-mold alternatives change sortability.
Do not use recyclable, mono-material, widely recyclable, reduced plastic, plastic-free, low impact, circular or sustainable packaging without component- and market-specific evidence.

exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: No material layer on the unit cup between direct print and foil; paper/fiber moves to L4 outer multipack only.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Opaque mineral-white primary vessel production baseline
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: Transparent validated food-contact vessel is the revision 7 target, with a hard barrier/light/shelf-life kill gate.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Fiber sleeve as brand, recipe, fact-panel and grip carrier
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: Front/back/bottom black direct-print zones on the transparent vessel; consumer grips the validated clear cup.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Sleeve tongue-and-slot, friction seam, separation notch and post-seal sleeve fitting
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: Direct print is applied and cured before fill; there is no unit-level paper assembly or separation action.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Dry-down step whose purpose was later sleeve assembly
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: Cold exterior condition remains a condensation/rub inspection point, not an assembly prerequisite.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Ingredient-color locator on foil tab, sleeve seam and multipack index
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: Actual visible food state plus black recipe name; no flavor-color ink on unit pack, and multipack remains black-led/open-sided.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Revision 6 screen-direction hex values as packaging print directions
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: The six food samples supply color. Hex values may remain digital brand references but do not print on the Clear Witness Cup.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Pale-mineral fiber surface as the source of tactile premium
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: Premium is expressed by truthful food visibility, accurate black registration, clear molded geometry and clean foil peel.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Unit-level paper, FSC, paper-sleeve, fiber-recovery and sleeve recyclability validation tracks
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: These tracks apply only to the outer multipack; the unit cup instead validates clear vessel, direct ink and foil structures.
Food-to-name continuity: visible food on the unit cup aligns with black recipe name and the open multipack recipe list.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Fiber curl, delamination, sleeve slip and accidental sleeve detachment as unit-pack failure modes
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: Clear-wall scuff, haze, wet-hand grip, black-print rub, background contrast and optical truth become unit-pack failure modes.

exact_removals_from_revision6.remove: Any image showing a paper collar, seam, sleeve removal or paper-like food-contact wall
exact_removals_from_revision6.replacement: Sealed clear cup, black direct print, flat foil peel, actual sidewall food and paper only as a separate outer carrier.

le_labo_boundary: No apothecary ruled label, ingredient-plus-number name, formula, compound, essence, elixir, tincture or blend-for-you language.
No customer name, city, maker signature, handwritten date or personalized label ritual.
No compressed wordmark, amber-vessel reference, pharmacy microtype or manifesto imitation.
Lot and date are factual production information only and never front-of-pack theater.
claims_held_for_validation: Greek Yogurt or equivalent category name
sealed for freshness, tamper-evident, easy peel, leak resistant or preserves flavor
clear, high barrier, low migration, food safe or light protective as consumer claims
recyclable, mono-material, reduced plastic, plastic-free, low impact, circular or sustainable
paper, certified fiber, recyclable or insulating multipack
handmade, artisan, small-batch, slow-infused, origin, nutrition, probiotic or health benefit
copy_and_claim_boundaries.claim_rule: Print only mandatory facts and claims supported by the approved recipe, component specification, line record, shelf-life/cold-chain study and applicable-market review. Visual transparency is not substantiation.

release_gates: Approved real food samples make six SKU states visible without artificial tint, garnish or image retouching.
Transparent vessel plus foil passes recipe-specific or justified worst-case light, barrier, migration, shelf-life and sensory studies.
Black direct print passes nested set-off, cure, migration, cold/wet rub, registration, legal copy, barcode and six-background contrast.
Black Sesame and every dark production-tolerant sample remain readable; any integrated non-paper fallback is minimized and fully revalidated.
Full-perimeter foil passes seal window, integrity, contamination control, peel, leak, drop and cold-chain distribution tests.
Consumer sequence passes wet-hand grip, foil-tab discovery, full removal, date-code finding and first-spoon comprehension.
Outer multipack passes restraint, humidity, drop, compression, airflow, barcode and refrigerated handling tests without being framed as insulation.
All mandatory label, category, allergen, quantity, date, storage, environmental and trademark reviews pass in the intended market.
Approved physical prototypes are photographed at sealed, sidewall, peeled, opened, first-spoon and sorted states; generated visuals do not close a gate.
global_boundaries: Transparent vessel, black direct print, foil structure, dimensions, 150 g format, copy zones and production methods remain directional until validation.
No individual paper or fiber label, collar, sleeve, adhesive sticker or ingredient-color print is part of the Clear Witness Cup.
Paper or fiber is limited to an outer multipack and does not contact food or provide the primary barrier.
Transparency does not prove food safety, freshness, quality, shelf life, light protection or sustainability.
The foil is a one-time seal, not a reclosure, and the board multipack does not refrigerate the product.
MORA and all recipe names are working names pending trademark, linguistic and food-label review.
No legal, recycling, environmental, origin, nutrition, health, probiotic or functional claim is introduced by this shard.

merge_intent.note: This revision supersedes revision 6 only for unit-pack architecture and packaging graphics. Keep revision 6 food-safety, seal, cold-chain and no-unsupported-claims discipline where not explicitly removed.
